newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-MAX'S LATE GOAL SAVES SCHALKE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAX'S LATE GOAL SAVES SCHALKE.

text.p: A 77th minute goal by Martin Max earned Germany's Schalke a 1-0 victory after a frustrating home leg against Turkey's Trabzonspor in the second round of the UEFA Cup on Tuesday.
Max got on the end of a cross from Czech international Jiri Nemec to head home at the left-hand post.
Trabzonspor's well-organised defence and midfield made life very difficult for Schalke for much of the game.
"It was a vital goal. But we saw that the Turks are very strong and we have a lot of work ahead in the second leg," Max said.
